# Aimad Ul Islam — Cybersecurity & Network Security Portfolio

> Cybersecurity student, SOC enthusiast, and network security learner from Pakistan. BSc Computer Science, Cisco certified.

## About
Aimad Ul Islam is a Cybersecurity student, SOC analyst enthusiast, and network security learner based in Pakistan. Specializes in Digital Forensics & Incident Response (DFIR), Security Operations Center (SOC) monitoring, Cisco networking, and ethical hacking.

## Professional Focus
- Security Operations Center (SOC) Analysis & Threat Detection
- Digital Forensics & Incident Response (DFIR)
- Network Security Engineering & Cisco Systems
- Threat Hunting & SIEM Log Analysis
- Vulnerability Assessment & Ethical Hacking

## Featured Projects



- [Automated Volatility 3 Memory Forensic Parser](https://aimadulislam.dpdns.org/projects/automated-memory-forensics/): A Python-based automated memory analysis parser that extracts processes, network sockets, DLL injections, and suspicious handles from Windows RAM dumps using Volatility 3.





## Security Research & Whitepapers



- [Zero-Trust Architecture &amp; Microsegmentation Framework 2026](https://aimadulislam.dpdns.org/research/zero-trust-architecture-2026/): An architectural guide on establishing zero-trust access, identity-aware proxies, and granular eBPF microsegmentation across hybrid multi-cloud environments.





## Virtual Security Labs & Walkthroughs



- [Enterprise Active Directory &amp; SOC Homelab Range](https://aimadulislam.dpdns.org/labs/active-directory-homelab/): Multi-VM Enterprise Active Directory lab featuring Windows Server 2022 Domain Controller, Windows 11 workstation targets, Sysmon, Splunk Universal Forwarders, and pfSense firewall segmentation.
